blocker.detail: HHY_PYTHON is not set in this worker environment, so the required governance command cannot be invoked through the controller-provided Python runtime.
blocker.resolution: Set HHY_PYTHON to a valid Python executable path for Windows workers, then rerun this attempt.
blocker.worker_result_evidence: PowerShell: `$env:HHY_PYTHON; Get-Location` produced an empty HHY_PYTHON value. Attempting `& $env:HHY_PYTHON tools/governance/hhy_governance.py active-task --format context` failed because the command expression was empty.

summary: Unable to start the Worker because the mandated HHY_PYTHON runtime is missing from the environment.
